description: Dependency updates for sealambda/chironium. sealambda/infra runs Renovate for every repository of the organization (its record 0021). The shared policy is in github>sealambda/.github.

packageRules.description: Phoenix ships each JavaScript client both in its Hex package and on npm. assets/package.json pins the npm copy to the version in mix.lock, so both move in one pull request.
The tools of mise.toml: one pull request for the minor and patch versions.
A person moves Elixir and Erlang in mise.toml together with the constraints above, which Renovate uses to update mix.lock.
pnpm of mise.toml moves with the packageManager field of package.json.

Docker images: the Dockerfile's builder and runner, the services of the compose files and the CI service containers. A registry other than Docker Hub gives no release dates, and without one minimumReleaseAge holds a digest back for ever, so an image with no date counts as old enough; Docker Hub's dates still apply.

A merge to main deploys to production, so a person merges every security fix, including one that changes only a lock file, unlike in the shared policy. This rule comes last, so that no rule above can turn the merge on.
